key_insight: MedMLX brings 21 established medical imaging AI models to Apple Silicon, matching original-software outputs in 211 of 212 comparisons.
clinical_relevance: Local execution could broaden researchers’ access to imaging AI without specialized NVIDIA hardware, but clinical performance was not established.
method: Reimplemented models in Apple’s MLX framework for segmentation, detection, image synthesis and report generation.
Compared outputs with original software running on an Intel CPU and NVIDIA GPU.
Measured memory use and processing time on an M1 Max with 64 GB memory.
evidence_signal: Testing used public cases from 11 datasets and required Dice ≥0.99 for every segmentation label; with memory-saving settings, 19 of 21 models used under 16 GB.
watch_item: Software-output agreement does not establish diagnostic accuracy or clinical safety; broader validation is needed before clinical deployment.
paper_title: MedMLX: On-Device Medical Imaging AI for Apple Silicon
